ValidationRule.description: Require select Payment Flow Fields on B2B Opp to move to Verbal 80%. SAL-3141 BOPI-526 updated to ignore Workato user BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", IsClosed = False, RecordType.Name = "B2B", DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) >= DATEVALUE("2023-12-18"), Probability >=0.80, OR( ISBLANK( Account.Annual_PYMT_Volume__c ), ISBLANK( Account.No_Annual_PYMT__c ), ISBLANK( Average_PYMNT_size__c ), ISBLANK( Total_Addressable_ARR__c ), ISBLANK( Total_Addressable_ARR_w_FW_Capabilities__c ), ISBLANK( Year_1_ARR_Projection__c ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following Fields are required: On Account: 'Annual PYMT Volume' , 'No. Annual PYMT' , On Opp: 'Average PYMNT Size' , 'Total Addressable ARR' , 'Total Addressable ARR w/ FW Capabilities' , 'Year 1 ARR Projection'
